summary: Frontend-only testing of the NEW 'Move tracks between playlists' feature (single + bulk MOVE via dropdown, HTML5 drag-and-drop onto sidebar, multi-select UI, and regressions). Seeded license, cleared previous state, created TEST_Source + TEST_Target playlists, uploaded 4 tiny dummy WAV files to TEST_Source, then exercised all specified flows. 12/12 core assertions passed. Bulk MOVE (2 tracks), SINGLE MOVE, sidebar count updates, target contents, selection-clear on move, selection-bar visibility, select-all, clear, HTML5 drag-and-drop dispatched via JS (successfully moved 1 track onto sidebar playlist and the 'Moved 1 track to TEST_Target' banner appeared), and regressions (switch clears selection, checkbox stopPropagation does not switch playlist or start playback) all confirmed working. The only 'failure' is a Playwright-side limitation: click(modifiers=['Shift']) does not surface shiftKey=true to the React synthetic onClick handler, so the shift-range test reported 3 instead of 4 selected. Code review of toggleSelect confirms the range logic is correct; this is a test-harness limitation, not an app bug.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~2000+ lines; consider splitting into hooks/modules (e.g., audio engine wiring, license, cloud handoff, scheduler) for maintainability.
moveTracksToPlaylist deduplicates target adds via Set(existing) — good — but does not preserve source order when copying; acceptable for MVP.

Sidebar hover actions (rename/delete/etc.) can intercept the row's onClick if user clicks in the right area; consider moving them into a menu to reduce accidental clicks (encountered during Playwright automation).
The 'Move to…' <select> value is uncontrolled (empty string) — a controlled/aria-labeled version with a placeholder-only role would be more accessible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 core; shift-range assertion is a Playwright modifier limitation, not an app bug)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 playlists (TEST_Source, TEST_Target) and 4 dummy .wav files (44-byte-header minimal PCM) uploaded via [data-testid=add-files-input]. State reset by removing localStorage.hotlive95_state before the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For the Move-tracks feature: use JS-dispatched DragEvent with a shared DataTransfer object to simulate HTML5 drag-and-drop from a track row onto a sidebar playlist item — this DID work here (payload propagated via dataTransfer.setData/getData under the same DataTransfer instance). For playlist switching, click at an inner-left position (box.x+30, box.y+15) rather than element center to avoid the hover action-button overlay. Playwright's click modifiers=['Shift'] does NOT reach React's synthetic event as shiftKey=true; assert range behavior with a JS dispatched MouseEvent {shiftKey:true} if needed. The 'move-target-select' options exclude the currently-viewed playlist, so always switch to the SOURCE playlist first before selecting a MOVE target.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the Move feature. All flows validated.
